label_support.description: Support rate among counter labels the packet ISSUES (counter_status in scored_statuses per RULES_LABEL.json). Cited status is EXCLUDED (NON_QUOTE_REF placeholder).
label_support.support_criteria: All five criteria (i-iv) from RULES_LABEL.json rubric.assignment_precedence must pass for SUPPORTED class.
label_support.n_scored: Count of rows with counter_status in scored_statuses
label_support.n_supported: Count of rows assigned SUPPORTED class by frozen rubric
label_support.support_rate: n_supported / n_scored if n_scored > 0 else null
label_support.abstention_count: Count of rows where counter_anchor classifier abstained (n_abstained from disclosures)
label_support.absolute_bar_predicate: LABEL_SOUND iff n_scored > 0 AND n_supported == n_scored (support_rate == 1.0). Per VERDICT_CONTRACT.json label_gate.absolute_status.
label_support.regression_verdict_predicate: Lineage check: set(bundle qids) == {de-kapitalverletzung, fr-bail-entretien, it-responsabilita-medica} AND n_scored == 65. If lineage: FAIL_REGRESSION if n_supported < 5, PASS_NO_REGRESSION if n_supported >= 5. Else NOT_APPLICABLE. Per VERDICT_CONTRACT.json label_gate.regression_verdict.

geometry.description: Per-criterion pass/fail on the SHIPPED post-rerank bundles (relevance_ordered variant) using frozen RULES_GEOMETRY.json criteria.
geometry.absolute_bar: 11 of 11 criteria must pass on EVERY bundle

mega_cluster_disclosure.definition: largest_cluster_size / n_decisions (size-based, len(idx) from cluster['size'] field)
mega_cluster_disclosure.note: Threshold unchanged; member_ids-based share is informational only

marginal_discovery.description: For every issued counter/contrary row, whether its decision_id was absent from the initial-pool top-K, its least-ranked list position, and whether a jurist scanning the ranked list would encounter it before the map.
marginal_discovery.K_definition: Conventional top-20 cutoff matching the pre-registered gate's route to positive q1/q3 (RULES_LABEL.json reporting.rank_distribution).
marginal_discovery.initial_pool_source: Bundle decisions ordered by retrieval relevance (rank field if present, else by order in bundle.decisions)
marginal_discovery.map_discovery_source: Counter-authority rows issued by the packet (counter_status in scored_statuses)
marginal_discovery.marginal_discovery: A counter authority is marginally discovered by the map iff its decision_id is NOT in the initial-pool top-K AND it appears in the map's counter-authority set.

verdict_rules.SERVE: BOTH frozen absolute bars met AS WRITTEN: (1) LABEL_SOUND (n_scored > 0 AND n_supported == n_scored) AND (2) geometry 11/11 on all three bundles AND (3) mega-cluster disclosure fires (share >= 0.5). NOTHING ELSE IS A SERVE PATH.
verdict_rules.DO_NOT_SERVE_UNCHANGED: Bars remain unmet as written; standing accepted DO-NOT-SERVE orders stand; owner_decision_required=false.
verdict_rules.BOUNDED_NEGATIVE: Both frozen absolute bars remain unmet AND no in-budget fix exists; promoted record is a bounded negative with at most ONE bounded cause per failed half. Converts map-versus-ranked-list choice into ONE explicit owner product decision ONLY IF owner_decision_required=true; otherwise stays recorded bounded negative. NO owner card, NO owner session, NO ready_for_owner_session=true, NO human_gate_ready=true from ANY outcome.

non_vacuity.requirement: Prove at least two criteria/verdicts can move under a seeded control, and prove the harness can output BOTH a serve and a do-not-serve outcome (negative control).

geometry_per_bundle.criteria: object<string, {value: number, bar: number, pass: boolean}>
